title: In the bedroom and bathroom
about: Things in the bedroom and the bathroom: bed, wardrobe, mirror, towel, toothbrush and more. What we do in the evening and in the morning: go to bed, fall asleep, wake up, get up, get dressed.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Багато вечірніх і ранкових дій англійською — це get + слово: get up, get dressed, get undressed, get into bed. Приймати душ — have a shower (британською) або take a shower (американською). Go to bed — без the; go upstairs, go downstairs — без to. Ось помилки, які часто роблять українці.

rows: I go to bed at eleven.
I go to the bed at eleven.
I accept a shower. / I make a shower.
I fell sleep. / I falled asleep.
I've got a new chest of drawers.

items.pattern: a bed · go to bed · in bed · make the bed
items.meaning: the thing you sleep on
items.example: My **bed** is next to the window.
more: My little brother has a **bed** that looks like a car.
I make my **bed** every morning before school.
items.watchOut: Go to bed і in bed — без the: I'm in bed. «Застелити ліжко» — make the bed.

items.pattern: a bedside lamp · turn on / turn off the bedside lamp
items.meaning: a small lamp next to your bed
items.example: Grandma bought me a new **bedside lamp** with stars on it.
more: The **bedside lamp** is too bright. I can't sleep.
Turn off your **bedside lamp**. It's late.

items.pattern: an alarm clock · set the alarm clock for 7 · the alarm clock rings / goes off
items.meaning: a clock that makes a loud noise to wake you up
items.example: My **alarm clock** looks like a cat.
more: I put my **alarm clock** on the other side of the room.
On holiday, I don't need an **alarm clock**.
items.watchOut: Будильник дзвонить — the alarm clock rings або goes off. «Поставити будильник на сьому» — set the alarm clock for seven (for, а не on).

items.pattern: my pyjamas (plural) · a pair of pyjamas · in my pyjamas
items.meaning: soft clothes you wear in bed
items.example: My new **pyjamas** have little bears on them.
more: My sister and I have the same **pyjamas**.
Pack your **pyjamas**. We're staying at Grandma's tonight.
items.watchOut: Піжама — одна річ, але англійською pyjamas завжди у множині: My pyjamas are blue (не is). Американське написання — pajamas.

items.pattern: a dressing table · sit at the dressing table
items.meaning: a table with drawers and a mirror in a bedroom
items.example: My sister's **dressing table** is full of hair clips.
more: There's a small chair in front of the **dressing table**.
Grandma's old **dressing table** has a big round mirror.
items.watchOut: Туалетний столик — dressing table. Не toilet table: toilet — це унітаз.

items.pattern: a chest of drawers · in the top / bottom drawer
items.meaning: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes
items.example: We painted my old **chest of drawers** white.
more: There's a photo of my family on top of the **chest of drawers**.
The **chest of drawers** is too heavy to move.
items.watchOut: Комод — chest of drawers. Англійське commode — зовсім інша річ, тож так не кажи. Drawer — шухляда, вимова /drɔː/.

items.pattern: a mirror · look in the mirror
items.meaning: a piece of glass where you can see yourself
items.example: My little sister likes making funny faces in the **mirror**.
more: There's a long **mirror** on the wardrobe door.
He looked in the **mirror** and smiled.
items.watchOut: Дивитися в дзеркало — look in the mirror (in). Look at the mirror — дивитися на саме дзеркало.

items.pattern: a wardrobe · in the wardrobe
items.meaning: a tall cupboard where you hang your clothes
items.example: Our cat likes to sleep on top of the **wardrobe**.
more: I've got a white **wardrobe** in my bedroom.
My brother and I share a big **wardrobe**.
items.watchOut: Шафа для одягу — wardrobe. Cupboard — шафа для посуду, їжі чи інших речей. Вимова: /ˈwɔːdrəʊb/.

items.pattern: a bedside table · on the bedside table
items.meaning: a small table next to your bed
items.example: My **bedside table** has one small drawer.
more: My cat sometimes sleeps on my **bedside table**.
We bought two white **bedside tables** for my parents' room.

items.pattern: a comb · comb your hair
items.meaning: a flat thing with thin teeth that makes your hair tidy
items.example: I keep a small **comb** in my school bag.
more: Dad **combs** his hair before he goes to work.
This **comb** is too small for my thick hair.
items.watchOut: Вимова: b у кінці не читається — /kəʊm/.

items.pattern: a hairbrush · brush your hair
items.meaning: a brush for your hair
items.example: My **hairbrush** is pink and has a long handle.
more: Don't use my **hairbrush**, please. Use your own.
The **hairbrush** is in the top drawer.
items.watchOut: Hairbrush — щітка для волосся, toothbrush — зубна щітка. Зазвичай пишуться разом.

items.pattern: a shower · in the shower
items.meaning: a thing in the bathroom that sends water down on you
items.example: My dad sings in the **shower** every morning.
more: The **shower** in our bathroom is next to the toilet.
Don't use all the hot water in the **shower**!
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈʃaʊə/, як flower. Приймати душ — have a shower (дивись частину C).

items.pattern: soap (uncountable) · a bar of soap · wash with soap
items.meaning: a thing you wash your hands and body with; it makes bubbles
items.example: There's no **soap** in the bathroom. Can you buy some?
more: Kids love making bubbles with **soap**.
I bought a bar of **soap** in the shape of a heart.
items.watchOut: Soap зазвичай незлічуване: some soap, a bar of soap. A soap частіше означає телесеріал (soap opera).

items.pattern: shampoo · wash your hair with shampoo
items.meaning: liquid soap for your hair
items.example: Mum's **shampoo** is in a green bottle.
more: My brother uses too much **shampoo**.
Is there any **shampoo** left?
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: sham-POO.

items.pattern: shower gel · a bottle of shower gel
items.meaning: liquid soap for your body in the shower
items.example: I got some **shower gel** for my birthday.
more: This **shower gel** is good for dry skin.
Put the **shower gel** back, please.

items.pattern: toothpaste (uncountable) · a tube of toothpaste
items.meaning: the thing you put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth
items.example: I like **toothpaste** that tastes of mint.
more: There's **toothpaste** on the basin again!
Don't forget the **toothpaste** when we go camping.
items.watchOut: Зубна паста — toothpaste, одним словом. Не просто pasta: pasta — це макарони!

items.pattern: a toothbrush · an electric toothbrush
items.meaning: a small brush for cleaning your teeth
items.example: My **toothbrush** is green.
more: Everyone in our family has a different colour **toothbrush**.
I always take my **toothbrush** when I stay with friends.

items.pattern: a razor · shave with a razor
items.meaning: a sharp thing people use to take hair off their face or legs
items.example: Grandpa uses an old **razor** that was his father's.
more: Dad's **razor** is electric, and it's very noisy.
I forgot my **razor**, so I couldn't shave on holiday.

items.pattern: the toilet · go to the toilet · flush the toilet
items.meaning: the thing in the bathroom you sit on; also the small room with it
items.example: Excuse me, where's the **toilet**?
more: The **toilet** is next to the shower.
Wash your hands after you go to the **toilet**.
items.watchOut: У Британії toilet — і унітаз, і кімната: Where's the toilet? В Америці частіше кажуть bathroom або restroom.

items.pattern: a shelf (plural: shelves) · on the shelf
items.meaning: a long flat board on the wall where you put things
items.example: My toys are on the top **shelf**.
more: Dad put up a new **shelf** in the bathroom.
We need more **shelves** for all our books.
items.watchOut: Множина — shelves: one shelf, two shelves.

items.pattern: a basin (UK) · wash your hands in the basin
items.meaning: the small bowl in the bathroom where you wash your hands and face
items.example: The **basin** is under the mirror.
more: Please clean the **basin** after you clean your teeth.
Our **basin** is white and round.
items.watchOut: У ванній — basin або washbasin (британською), на кухні — sink. Американці кажуть sink і про ванну.

items.pattern: a towel · dry yourself with a towel
items.meaning: a soft piece of cloth for drying your body
items.example: I've got a big blue **towel** with my name on it.
more: Hang your wet **towel** on the hook.
There are three **towels** in the bathroom, one for each of us.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈtaʊəl/ — «тауел», а не «товел».

items.pattern: go to bed (no the) · go to bed early / late · go to bed at 10
items.meaning: go to your bed to sleep
items.example: My grandparents **go to bed** very early.
more: What time did you **go to bed** last night?
Clean your teeth before you **go to bed**.
items.watchOut: Без the: go to bed. Go to the bed означає просто підійти до ліжка.

items.pattern: go upstairs (no to) · be upstairs
items.meaning: go to a higher floor in a house
items.example: Leave your shoes here and **go upstairs** to wash your hands.
more: The children **went upstairs** to play.
We **went upstairs** to look at the view from the window.
items.watchOut: Без to: go upstairs, а не go to upstairs. Так само go downstairs.

items.pattern: get undressed (got undressed)
items.meaning: take off your clothes
items.example: He **got undressed** and put his school uniform on the chair.
more: I **get undressed** in the bathroom because it's warmer there.
My little brother can **get undressed** by himself now.
items.watchOut: Роздягнутися — зазвичай get undressed. Зняти одну річ — take off: take off your coat.

items.pattern: get into bed · be in bed · get out of bed
items.meaning: go into your bed and lie down
items.example: I **got into bed** and my cat jumped up next to me.
more: The sheets were nice and clean when I **got into bed**.
Come on, **get into bed**. It's late.
items.watchOut: Get into bed — лягти в ліжко (рух). In bed — бути в ліжку. Get out of bed — вилізти з ліжка.

items.pattern: read for a bit · play / wait for a bit
items.meaning: read for a short time
items.example: On the train, I **read for a bit** and then looked out of the window.
more: Let's sit in the garden and **read for a bit**.
Before bed, Mum **read for a bit**, and my little brother fell asleep.
items.watchOut: For a bit — «трохи, недовго», так кажуть у розмові: wait for a bit, play for a bit.

items.pattern: turn off the light · turn the light off · turn on the light
items.meaning: make the light go off
items.example: Don't forget to **turn off the light** when you leave the room.
more: I **turned off the light**, but I couldn't sleep.
Who **turned off the light**? I can't see!
items.watchOut: Вимкнути світло — turn off (або switch off) the light, а не close the light. Увімкнути — turn on.

items.pattern: fall asleep (fell asleep) · fall asleep on the sofa
items.meaning: start to sleep
items.example: The baby **fell asleep** in the car.
more: My sister **fell asleep** on the plane and missed the film.
Reading in bed helps me **fall asleep**.
items.watchOut: Минулий час — fell asleep. Не fell sleep і не falled asleep.

items.pattern: wake up (woke up) · wake sb up
items.meaning: stop sleeping
items.example: I **woke up** early because the sun was shining into my room.
more: Please **wake** me **up** at eight.
My little brother **wakes up** at six every day.
items.watchOut: Wake up — прокинутися (розплющити очі). Get up — встати з ліжка. Можна прокинутися о сьомій, а встати о восьмій.

items.pattern: get up (got up) · get up early / late
items.meaning: get out of bed after sleeping
items.example: On Sundays we **get up** late and have pancakes.
more: My mum **gets up** before everyone else.
I **got up**, opened the curtains and looked at the snow.

items.pattern: have a shower (UK) · take a shower (US) · have a bath
items.meaning: wash your body under a shower
items.example: I **have a shower** after every swimming lesson.
more: Can I **have a shower** before dinner?
Dad is **having a shower**, so wait a minute.
items.watchOut: Приймати душ — have a shower (британською) або take a shower (американською). Не accept a shower і не make a shower. Так само have a bath — прийняти ванну.

items.pattern: clean / brush your teeth · clean my / her teeth
items.meaning: make your teeth clean with a toothbrush
items.example: She **cleans her teeth** for two minutes.
more: Did you **clean your teeth**?
We **clean our teeth** after breakfast.
items.watchOut: Чистити зуби — clean або brush your teeth, з my / your / her. Не wash your teeth. Один зуб — tooth, зуби — teeth.

items.pattern: get dressed (got dressed) · get dressed quickly
items.meaning: put your clothes on
items.example: My little sister is very slow when she **gets dressed**.
more: I **got dressed** in the dark and put on two different socks!
Dad helps my baby brother **get dressed**.
items.watchOut: Одягнутися — get dressed, а не dress me. Одягнути одну річ — put on: put on your coat.

items.pattern: go downstairs (no to) · be downstairs
items.meaning: go to a lower floor in a house
items.example: I **went downstairs** quietly so I didn't wake my parents.
more: On Christmas morning the kids **went downstairs** to look for their presents.
Can you **go downstairs** and get my glasses?

warmup.explain: Вимкнути світло — turn off (або switch off) the light. Close — закривати двері чи вікно.

warmup.uk: Я чищу зуби двічі на день.
warmup.q: I ___ my teeth twice a day.
warmup.explain: Чистити зуби — clean або brush your teeth, не wash.
Прокидатися — wake up. Get up — вставати з ліжка, це вже наступний крок.
Приймати душ — have a shower (UK) або take a shower (US).

warmup.uk: Я одягаюся і йду до школи.

warmup.explain: Піжама — pyjamas, завжди у множині. Nightdress — нічна сорочка.
Комод — chest of drawers. Dressing table — туалетний столик.
Лягати спати — go to bed, без the.

A.q: Your clothes are all on the floor! Put them in the ___.
My ___ have blue and white stripes, and I sleep in them every night.
A.explain: У піжамі сплять — pyjamas, завжди у множині.

A.q: My hair is very short, so I just use a ___, not a hairbrush.

B.q: I can't wash my hair. There's no ___ left.
Can I have a clean ___? I want to dry my hands.
Dad cut his chin with his new ___ this morning.

C.q: The birds were so loud this morning that I ___ at five!
C.explain: Прокинувся — woke up (минулий час від wake up).

C.q: Before he left the room, he ___ the light.
C.explain: Вимкнути світло — turn off the light, не close.

C.q: First I have a shower, then I ___ and go to school.
C.explain: Після душу одягаються — get dressed. Get undressed — роздягатися.

example.title: A sleepover at Mia's
example.uk:
Минулої п'ятниці я ночувала в моєї подруги Мії. Я взяла з собою піжаму, зубну щітку і маленький рушник.

О десятій ми піднялися нагору до її кімнати. Ми почистили зуби й лягли в ліжко. Ми трохи почитали, а потім Мія вимкнула світло. Я заснула дуже швидко.

Вранці о восьмій задзвонив будильник Мії. Ми встали, одяглися і спустилися вниз. Її тато спік на сніданок млинці!
example.en:
Last Friday I stayed at my friend Mia's house. I took my [[pyjamas|a4]], my [[toothbrush|b6]] and a small [[towel|b11]].

At ten we [[went upstairs|c2]] to her room. We [[cleaned our teeth|c11]] and [[got into bed|c4]]. We [[read for a bit|c5]], and then Mia [[turned off the light|c6]]. I [[fell asleep|c7]] very quickly.

In the morning Mia's [[alarm clock|a3]] rang at eight. We [[got up|c9]], [[got dressed|c12]] and [[went downstairs|c13]]. Her dad made pancakes for breakfast!
